\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Product co-presence as collaboration} & REJECT & Two products on one PR do not establish an addressed or sequential edge \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Burst-collapsed next public owner} & MAIN & Ordering remains stable across thresholds and leave-one-group checks \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Cross-product versus same-product visibility} & MAIN & Exact-author matched contrast remains negative with repository resampling \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Prior same-repository review history of user-account bridge} & MAIN & Strict pre-trigger different-PR history is common and concentration checks pass \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Experienced accounts are preferentially selected first} & REJECT & The all-responder comparison differs little and channel or account dependence remains \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Hybrid automation-then-user route and later merge} & SECONDARY & Positive pretrigger-adjusted association triangulates the exact-edge result in a broader fixed-landmark cohort \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Exact addressed reply and later merge} & MAIN & Pre-landmark association is stable across reply windows and product-pair exclusions \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Exact edge versus non-exact public discussion} & MAIN & The association remains positive inside PRs with visible discussion and under overlap weighting; repository fixed effects are imprecise \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Special same-product temporal persistence} & APPENDIX & Observed ordering is reproduced by the within-PR product-composition placebo \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Repeated automation naturally escalates to a user} & REJECT & The apparent dose curve is reproduced by within-PR order permutation \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{One-way user takeover after a rapid burst} & REJECT & The next visible owner bounces in both directions and same-layer persistence is similar for user-first and product-first states \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Prior-review history causes later merge} & REJECT & The positive pooled association does not survive strong within-repository comparisons \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Semantic duplication or complementarity at the same locus} & PENDING & Structural cohort is ready but dual coding and product-pair generality gates remain open \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Intentional routing to the triggering reviewer product} & REJECT & Review-request assignee coverage is zero \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Second-brand adoption expands repository task breadth} & REJECT & The pattern fails longer-history and rarefaction sensitivity checks \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Exact-file succession is a true task handoff} & REJECT & File reuse alone fails the task-identity audit \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Independent CodAGE product-attribution agreement} & APPENDIX & Exact product pairs and trigger times agree in the overlap but only nine exposed PRs remain for an outcome check \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{SWE-Review-Chat exact-edge outcome replication} & REJECT & All seven PRs whose exact-alias cross-product inline parent has a nested reply are already in the complete AIDev backbone leaving zero disjoint REST or landmark rows \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Transferred actionability text classifier} & REJECT & Leave-one-source-out discrimination is weak for human review and one AI-review tool so the proxy is not stable enough for AIDev claims \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Unmeasured-confounding bounds for the addressed edge} & MAIN & E-value 2.27 and an explicit tipping grid state the minimum strength a confounder would need instead of only warning that one could exist \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Pre-trigger placebo outcomes for the addressed edge} & MAIN & Eleven of twelve models cover the null at the same specification and the exposure cannot cause an outcome completed before the trigger \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{One-hour reply window as the primary exposure} & REJECT & The pre-trigger user-activity placebo excludes the null at one hour so a very fast exact reply is selected by PRs that already had a person acting \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Repository-stratified randomisation inference} & SECONDARY & A design-based reference distribution confirms the clustered interval is not an artefact of 109 exposed PRs \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Addressed edge as an agent-to-agent relay} & REJECT & Only three of 128 exposure events are written by a different mapped product so the edge is a human acknowledgement in this cohort \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Addressed edge under stricter exposure definitions} & MAIN & Dropping the triggering product's own replies and requiring a user-account reply both keep the estimate positive with overlapping intervals \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Landmark cohort as a general population estimate} & REJECT & The cohort is the 27 percent of cross-product inline triggers still open at hour 48 so the estimate describes slower-resolving PRs only \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Conditional within-repository randomisation test} & MAIN & Restricting to repositories that can be re-randomised and adding repository fixed effects centres the reference distribution and gives a two-sided p of 0.007 \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Whole-population time-varying edge model} & MAIN & Dropping the hour-48 restriction and letting the edge switch on in time leaves the odds of merging about 1.7 times higher across every control set \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Repository familiarity as the mechanism behind the edge} & REJECT & The prior-reviewer minus newcomer gap is large overall but shrinks to near zero with an interval spanning it once the comparison is held inside one repository \\
\multicolumn{2}{@{}L{0.325\textwidth}}{Edge-class description by who wrote the reply} & APPENDIX & Informative about where the association sits but confounded with the repository so it cannot support a mechanism claim \\
